The '''riot shield''' was a [[personal energy shield]] used by [[Law enforcement agency|law enforcement]] and [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary defense forces]]. Constructed with a metal frame, it generated an energy shield that was opaque to anyone who viewed it from the outside, thus inhibiting the opponent's view of the wielder. However, the inner side of the energy shield was transparent, allowing the wielder to have clear vision through the shield.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" /> Other versions were [[Shield (physical armor)/Legends|physical shields]], such as the riot shields carried by the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].

The shield could also be used as a melee weapon, striking with the energy shield and dealing damage equivalent to a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

Riot shields were used by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] and [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] troopers during the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
